groups.name: Custom LiveSplit Plugins
groups.description: Timing, subsplits and layout components. Install and update each one separately.

packages.name: NSMBW Custom Dolphin
packages.description: Dolphin configured for NSMBW practice, retiming and individual levels.

release.notes: Imported user v7, the newest user-facing build. Uses Dolphin.exe and its complete release folder. Update comparison uses 0.0.7 while the library displays User build v7.

details.summary: The user distribution of your custom Dolphin fork. Its built-in NSMBW selector opens when Dolphin starts without a game.
features: Select Practice, Retime or IL mode inside Dolphin.
Bundled mode-specific Riivolution patch data.
Practice allows savestates; Retime and IL enforce their mode restrictions.
setup: Select your own base NSMBW disc image in Dolphin.
The launcher keeps Qt, Languages, Sys and patch files together.
Windows 10 version 1903 or newer; Microsoft Visual C++ x64 runtime may be required.
The user build is selected for distribution; master and benchmark builds are excluded.

packages.name: NSMBW Retimer
packages.description: Review run footage, mark loads and compare against a TAS reference.

release.notes: Normalized release 1.0, including the TAS overlay offset fix. Uses the exact 1.0/standalone folder requested.

details.summary: Your dedicated retiming desktop app, using the normalized 1.0 release you specified.
features: Open video and mark load start/end points with frame controls.
Review run summaries and save retime files.
Load TAS video or .lds references and work with the TAS overlay.
setup: This uses the self-contained standalone EXE from artifacts/1.0.
Open a video or an existing retime file from the File menu.
Older Fixed, Updated and 1.0.1 artifacts are intentionally not selected.

packages.name: SM64 Practice
packages.description: Build practice goals and track star PBs in a desktop overlay.

release.notes: Imported the self-contained sendable build. Prepared a new ZIP containing both the EXE and presets.json because the existing Windows x64 ZIP contains only the EXE.

details.summary: The self-contained SM64 Practice Overlay build, packaged with the presets from your sendable release folder.
features: Stage-wide overhaul goals and single-star grinds.
Separate always-on-top overlay for your practice text.
Star PB tracking, strategy selection and xcam sheet imports.
setup: Includes the .NET runtime; the small Discord build is not selected.
Your presets.json and untracked user files are kept during launcher updates.
Use the app’s preset editor to set up your own practice goals.

release.notes: Canonical release: v206-render-pipeline-fix. Imported checksum matches current-plugins.json.

details.summary: Displays your split list using the Better Subsplits component.
setup: Close LiveSplit before installing or updating this component.
Choose the folder containing LiveSplit.exe in Settings. RPM installs only this DLL into Components.
Add the component from the LiveSplit Edit Layout menu. Existing untracked DLLs are preserved; back them up before replacing them.

packages.name: NSMBW Autosplitter
packages.description: Read the timer from your capture feed and send splits automatically.

release.notes: NSMBW Autosplitter 2.1.0: SCU Direct Frames capture, independent timer and picture crops, stalled-capture detection, updated icon and interface fixes.

details.summary: A capture-window OCR utility for the on-screen run timer. Train the timer font, then send detected times to your timing workflow.
features: Crop and train against your capture window.
Read and type a time manually, or watch continuously.
Configure LiveSplit start/stop hotkeys and automatic attempt resets.
setup: Requires the .NET 8 Windows Desktop runtime for the small build.
Open your capture window, configure the timer crop, train a sample and test OCR.
Capture settings and timer templates are saved beside the EXE.

packages.name: AS64++
packages.description: Automatically split Super Mario 64 runs from captured gameplay.

release.notes: Complete AS64++ 1.0.62 application build with libraries and capture resources. Runtime log excluded. OBS frame-grabber plugin must be installed separately.

details.summary: A customized AutoSplit64 fork that watches console gameplay and controls LiveSplit, with route editing, star detection and reset template profiles.
features: Automatic splits, star counting and console reset detection.
OBS frame-grabber or window capture input.
Custom routes, LiveSplit split-file conversion and reset profiles.
setup: Requires Windows 10+, LiveSplit 1.8.29+, and a capture feed. OBS integration requires OBS 30+.
Set LiveSplit to start at 1.36 seconds, configure capture, choose or import a route, then generate reset templates.
Access capture and route controls from the AS64++ right-click menu.
For OBS integration, install the AS64+ frame-grabber plugin separately. This release folder does not include its DLL. Window capture is also available.
Routes, config.ini and generated templates are kept during launcher updates.

packages.name: SCU
packages.description: Capture, replay and record your speedruns.

release.notes: Detected local build 1.0.305. Review this release before publishing.

details.summary: Speedrun Capture Utility brings capture-card preview, replay, recording and export into a dedicated Windows tool.
features: Live capture preview with replay and recording controls.
Full controls for audio, streaming and export.
setup: Install FFmpeg from SCU → Settings → General → FFmpeg Tools when you need its media tools.

packages.name: GCord
packages.description: Voice rooms and shared game feeds for speedrunning crews.

release.notes: Detected local build 0.1.31. Review this release before publishing.

details.summary: A native Windows launcher for GCord’s voice and virtual-camera rooms. This release connects to the hosted control service and LiveKit media service.
features: Create a private room and share an invite.
Publish your microphone, camera and a separate game feed.
Use OBS Virtual Camera as the bridge for an SCU capture feed.
setup: Requires an internet connection and a supported Chromium browser.
Server, diagnostics and mobile packages are not installed with the desktop client.
Launch the portable GCord executable.
